title: Same word, any case
prompt: Return true if a and b are the same word ignoring capital letters, so "Godot" and "GODOT" match.
signature: func solve(a: String, b: String) -> bool:
starter:
func solve(a: String, b: String) -> bool:
	return a == b
hint: Make both the same case before comparing.
solution:
func solve(a: String, b: String) -> bool:
	return a.to_lower() == b.to_lower()
